fact: what3words says Djibouti Post adopted its three-word addressing as an addressing standard, and that every location in Djibouti now has an instant address.
what3words and Djibouti Post's CEO say every place in the country, from Balbala to Obock and Assa Geyla, now has a fixed address under the system.

The PROGOUV terms of reference say street addressing exists only in a few central streets and in Ras Dika commune, with street plates but no door numbers, that a pilot ran in Cite Nassib (Balbala), and that the Mairie holds DJF 70 million for 2023 addressing and seeks an expert to define a city addressing strategy.
